I answered Marcus in his #north-team thread: the main contact for the duplicate door 6 arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **Thea Ramaswell**.

That comes from Dana's post in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025, a channel Marcus is in. She wrote that Thea had flagged duplicate door 6 arrivals on the morning shift again. The same trailer showed up as two rows because the driver checked in at the kiosk and dispatch then added him manually. Dana owns the account now and said she'd look into it, so I suggested Marcus ping her too.

I only used sources Marcus can see. I left out Thea's job title, because it only appears in an account profile and contract that aren't visible to him.
